svg.title: A nurse is changing the linens on an occupied bed. Which of the following actions should the nurse take?
svg.desc: Rolling the used linen under the client, guarding the turning side with a rail, and eliminating wrinkles keep the client safe and protect skin from pressure and shear. Soiled linen held against the uniform contaminates the nurse's clothing, and shaking linens sends organisms into the air.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Occupied Bed
Read the situation
A nurse is changing the linens on an
occupied bed. Which of the following
actions should the nurse take?
What fits here
Turn the client to one side and roll the
used linens toward the client's back ·
Raise the side rail on the far side before
turning the client toward it · Smooth the
clean bottom sheet so…
Why it fits
Rolling the used linen under the client,
guarding the turning side with a rail, and
eliminating wrinkles keep the client safe
and protect skin from pressure and shear.
Soiled linen held against the uniform
contaminates the nurse's clothing, and
shaking linens sends organisms into the
air.
